board_roster_reviewed: Eleven directors at listing: Executive: Liu Heng (chair/CEO, co-founder), Sun Bill Nai-chau, Xie Ming (all insiders). Non-executive: Lin Jian (appointed Oct 2022; investment director of Shenzhen Oriental Fortune Capital Investment Management - the parent of the managers of OFC Bohui Fund and OFC Jiaozi Fund, pre-IPO investors) - LINKED; Gu Qin (appointed Oct 2022; chief accountant of Shanghai Tongrui Investment Management, executive partner/fund manager of Huzhou Youxing, Suzhou Lianrui, Huzhou Youcheng, Suzhou Youxin, pre-IPO investors) - LINKED; Xue Di (appointed May 2025 = Series C date; deputy director of Shanghai Hehong Jinghui Equity Investment Management, executive partner of Qingdao Hongyi, a Series C pre-IPO investor) - LINKED; Chen Kan (appointed May 2025; non-executive director of InSilico Medicine; no pre-IPO investor link identified in prospectus). INEDs effective at Listing: Siu Paul Yu Hay, Ruan Tim, Yang Chun, Zhou Guofang (not linked; not fully assessed beyond roster).
rights_and_timing: Pre-IPO investors held customary rights incl. redemption, veto over major matters of the shareholders meeting and board, ROFR, anti-dilution, liquidation preference, drag-along; the prospectus text does not list an explicit board nomination or observer right. Redemption right against the company ceased 30 May 2025; redemption against Dr. Liu ceased before listing application (reinstates if listing fails); other special rights terminate upon Listing. The board seats themselves are held by NEDs who are executives of pre-IPO investor institutions/managers (seats, not just rights), in place at the prospectus date, with Lin Jian and Gu Qin appointed 20 Oct 2022 and Xue Di and Chen Kan on 19 May 2025 (Series C agreement date). Nominee status is inferred from employment, not stated.
